module: "Color Presets" section of the Dynamic Decals tool. List of named colors stored in the preference `dynamicDecalsTool.colorPresets.presets` (about 42 by default: "iconic oraNGe", Aquamarine, Burgundy, Jet Black...). Each entry {name, value={r,g,b,a}} can be edited, renamed, deleted, filtered by name, and applied as a decal or fill layer color.
notes: The search field is labeled "Texture Filter" (copied from another section) although it filters color names.
The "Add color preset" button inserts an orange color (1, 0.4, 0, 1) without a name; newPreset.name is not used.
The table `newPreset.value` is shared between all added presets: they reference the same Lua table until the preference is read again.

onGui.desc: Draws the search filter, the preset list (color widget, name, buttons delete / apply as decal color via api.setDecalColor / apply as fill layer color via api.setFillLayerColor) and the add button. Serves both as section content and as the editor of the `presets` preference.

registerEditorPreferences.desc: Registers the subcategory `dynamicDecalsTool.colorPresets` with the `presets` table (default list of named colors) and its graphical editor (onGui).

editorPreferenceValueChanged.desc: Hook called when a preference changes. Does nothing here.

setup.desc: Called by the tool: gets the API and docs, registers the "Color Presets" section (order 121) and its documentation page.
